core.title: Decode the nominal train and its keep/pivot/kill sibling trains
core.given: Wagons and WMBTs for a main job have been kept.
core.when: The planner decodes the journey that realizes that main job.
core.then: Define the nominal train (the happy-path journey realizing the main job) and, alongside it, decide each error, alternate and exception sibling train with an explicit operator keep, pivot or kill.
prefer: Decode the nominal train first, then enumerate error, alternate and exception siblings against it.
Record the keep/pivot/kill decision for every sibling train next to the nominal train.
avoid: Decoding trains before wagons and WMBTs have been kept.
Planning only the happy path and leaving error/alternate/exception journeys undecided.
Adding sibling trains without an operator keep/pivot/kill decision.
core.why: The nominal and sibling trains are what a journey composes across interlockings; decoding them after wagons/WMBTs are kept, with explicit keep/pivot/kill on siblings, makes non-happy-path scope a deliberate decision rather than an omission.
evidence: The plan names a nominal train that realizes the main job via the kept wagons/WMBTs.
Each error, alternate and exception sibling train in the plan carries an operator keep, pivot or kill decision.
verification: Fires only during planning/decomposition, after wagons and WMBTs have passed keep/pivot/kill; that phase state needs a new observer, so a realization must add one or judge it from the plan content.

Compliance is judged from plan content (llm_judged), not from file kinds or paths: the check asks whether the plan names a nominal train realizing the main job via the kept wagons/WMBTs, and whether each error, alternate and exception sibling train carries an explicit operator keep, pivot or kill decision.

Terms of the check: nominal_train is the happy-path journey realizing the main job; sibling_trains are the error, alternate and exception journeys decided by keep/pivot/kill alongside the nominal train.

values: kept wagons/WMBTs without a decoded nominal train
nominal train without sibling trains decided

fires: Planner has kept wagons and WMBTs and now authors the train/journey for the main job.
A plan defines the happy-path train but has not decided error, alternate or exception sibling trains.
doesNotFire: Wagons and WMBTs are still being proposed or have not yet passed keep/pivot/kill.
Coder implementing an already-planned acceptance with no plan or journey authoring.

classification.note: Neutral as-is; wagons and WMBTs are cross-stack ATDD plan artifacts, not stack or path names.

Neutral ordering guidance at plan level.

Neutral ordering prohibition, mirrors the given/activation gate.

neutralityNotes: The whole convention is planner-methodology, so the core carries it almost verbatim: wagons, WMBTs, trains, journeys, interlockings and keep/pivot/kill are cross-stack ATDD planning concepts (the closed vocabulary itself ships wagon/wmbt/train/journey artifact types and URN shapes), not stack, runtime, framework, language, suffix or path names. The verifier terms nominal_train and sibling_trains and their definitions are likewise neutral planning vocabulary and stay in the core's verification (audit r2). Nothing is Bun-specific enough for bunOnly; the per-fact observer notes' load-bearing part survives as the facts' observability values plus the core's first verification entry. The single thing the core needs from a profile is which concrete kinds play the plan-artifact role (roles.plan_artifact.kinds); no proposed key was needed.
